purpose: Teach: 祖先/生前/独断/戦死/胎児/判別/二酸化炭素/裁定

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の祖先関連を警察、確認されたんですね
lines.en: We've confirmed the suspect's family background details in this case.
lines.style: Measured and official. Steady pace, clear enunciation. The tone of someone stating facts that have been verified. No inflection seeking confirmation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害者の生前の関係を、警察、調査中ですね
lines.en: The police are still investigating the victim's relationships before death.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Quiet curiosity — not challenging, but genuinely wondering. Slow, careful diction. Slight lift at the end, genuine question.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、独断的な決定はしません
lines.en: The police won't make unilateral decisions about this.
lines.style: Firm but not cold. Direct eye contact level. Clear emphasis on the negative — this is reassurance through procedure. Professional but not detached.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、戦死者の遺族支援、警察、関与されているそうですね
lines.en: I understand the police are involved in supporting the families of the war dead in this case.
lines.style: Reflective, almost hesitant phrasing. Soft voice — respect for the weight of what he's saying. A pause before the key phrase. Not performing emotion, but present with it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、胎児にも危険のあった事件を慎重に扱います
lines.en: The police handle cases involving fetal risk with extreme care.
lines.style: Lower register, grave. Each phrase deliberate and weighted. Slow delivery, no rush. The gravity of what's being said is carried in the pacing, not the volume.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、指紋判別を成功されたんですね
lines.en: We were successful in the fingerprint analysis on this case.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction in the voice. The relief of work done carefully and well. Measured pace. Not triumphant — professional acknowledgment of a breakthrough.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、二酸化炭素濃度の異常を現場で確認しました
lines.en: We identified an unusual concentration of carbon dioxide at the scene.
lines.style: Clinical precision. Each fact stated with the same level of importance. Cool, observational tone. The detail of a report being delivered without interpretation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、裁判所の裁定を待っております
lines.en: We're awaiting the court's ruling on this matter.
lines.style: Formal closure. Measured breath at the end of the sentence. The finality of something now out of police hands. Professional, patient, resolved.
